meta.title: iOS Simulator Helper
meta.description: Unofficial helper for Apple's iOS Simulator: 21 native ios_* tools covering Xcode project discovery, build, install, launch, screenshots and logs, plus the simulator, idb backend and xcodebuild parameters on this plugin's page in the Plugins panel. Not affiliated with Apple.

settings.intro: Changes are saved to this profile and take effect on the next tool call.
settings.invalid: Enter a whole number, or leave blank to use the default.
settings.writeBlocked: One value is invalid; fix it before saving
settings.writeFailed: These values were not accepted, so they are still staged.
settings.unavailable: This plugin's settings are not served, so it cannot be configured right now.
settings.hostUnsupportedBody: The host reports {platform}, which is not macOS. The iOS Simulator workflow needs Xcode, xcrun simctl and a simulator window app (Simulator.app on Xcode 25 and earlier, Device Hub on Xcode 26 and later), so every ios_* tool refuses to run here.
settings.hostUnknown: Host system: could not be determined.
settings.toolsHint: The diagnostic runs the same checks as ios_preflight in the app. Discovery refreshes the simulator and runtime suggestions offered by the fields above.
settings.unsupported: Unsupported host: no simulator tool can run here.
settings.group.target.hint: Which simulator to use, and whether it is booted and shown automatically when needed.
settings.field.defaultDevice.hint: A device-name fragment such as "iPhone 17" or "iPad mini". Used when a tool names no udid/device; falls back to the first available iPhone.
settings.field.defaultRuntime.hint: A runtime-name fragment such as "iOS-27"; empty matches any runtime.
settings.field.autoBootSimulator.hint: When off, tools fail instead of running simctl boot when the target simulator is not booted.
settings.field.autoOpenSimulator.hint: Open the simulator window app for boot/show/open-url/build-and-run: Simulator.app on Xcode 25 and earlier, Device Hub on Xcode 26 and later. A window that cannot open never fails the simctl work; turn this off to stay headless.
settings.field.bootTimeoutSeconds.hint: Longest wait for one simctl boot / bootstatus command; 120 seconds by default.
settings.group.ui.hint: The idb backend behind ios_ui_tap / swipe / type_text / button / describe.
settings.field.uiBackend.hint: auto probes for idb; idb requires it; none disables the UI tools; xcodebuildmcp is reserved and not implemented.
settings.field.idbBinary.hint: Command name or absolute path of idb; keep the default when idb is already on PATH.
settings.field.uiTimeoutSeconds.hint: Longest runtime of one idb UI command; 60 seconds by default.
settings.group.build.hint: The xcodebuild configuration, its extra arguments, and where products land.
settings.field.defaultConfiguration.hint: Used when a tool names no configuration; the original plugin also defaulted to Debug.
settings.field.buildTimeoutSeconds.hint: Longest runtime of one xcodebuild build; 600 seconds by default.
settings.field.extraBuildArgs.hint: One argument per line, `#` starts a comment; inserted after -derivedDataPath and before "build".
settings.field.derivedDataDir.hint: Empty uses `DerivedData/<project fingerprint>` under the data directory, as the original did.
settings.field.disableCodeSigning.hint: The original always passed CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO; turn this off to let Xcode decide.
settings.group.logs.hint: The window and size ios_logs reads by default.
settings.field.logSeconds.hint: Seconds of recent log ios_logs reads when the call names none; capped at 3600.
settings.field.logLimit.hint: Largest rendered log ios_logs returns when the call names no limit.
settings.group.output.hint: Where screenshots, build logs and DerivedData are written.
settings.field.dataDir.hint: Root for screenshots, logs and DerivedData; empty uses $DSH_HOME/ios-simulator-helper, then ~/.dsh/ios-simulator-helper.
settings.field.screenshotDir.hint: Empty uses `screenshots` under the data directory.
